label: You always knew
blurb: Since the age of reason, more or less. There was never a serious alternative.
outcome: Your piety has a floor other men envy and a ceiling they do not see: you have never had to choose this, so you do not yet know what choosing it costs. When the doubt comes, and it will, it will come as a stranger.

label: Something happened
blurb: A night, a room, a moment you have described to three people and never accurately.
outcome: You know what grace feels like, which is a gift and a liability. You will measure every dry year against that one night. The men who never had it will find you slightly alarming.

hooks.label: The night you have never described accurately

label: A priest who marked you
blurb: One man, one parish, one example that made the whole thing look possible.
outcome: You have a model, which means you have a standard, which means you will be disappointed by most of the presbyterate and by yourself. He is still alive. He will have opinions about your assignments, and you will care what he thinks for longer than is sensible.

label: You argued yourself into it
blurb: Books first, then the Church, then the priesthood, in that order and with footnotes.
outcome: Your faith has a spine of argument, and it will hold when feeling fails. It will also make you impatient with people whose faith is mostly feeling, which is most people. The faculty will steer you toward a doctorate before you have unpacked.

label: After a loss
blurb: Someone died, and afterward the life you had planned did not make sense.
outcome: You know what the grieving need because you needed it, and the ones who did it well and badly for you are in your memory forever. Anniversaries will find you. The doubt, when it comes, will ask whether you are here for God or for the dead.

hooks.label: The one whose death sent you here

label: You were running from something
blurb: You have a better answer for the vocation director, and it is also true. But this is the truer one.
outcome: The seminary is a good place to hide and a terrible place to stay hidden. What you ran from will find you, probably in the fourth year, probably at the worst time. If you can stand still when it does, you will be a priest people can tell the truth to.

effects.value: The thing he was running from
